description.zh: 支持配置多个插件库，读取各库 index.json 汇总可安装插件，并在页面里直接完成安装与升级；启动后在后台自动检查更新，页面用「可更新 / 已安装 / 可安装 / 插件库 / 信息」五个页签切换二级内容。
description.en: Configure several plugin libraries, read each index.json to list installable plugins, and install or upgrade right from the page. Updates are checked in the background; the page switches between Updates / Installed / Installable / Libraries / Info via tabs.
